narrow_historical_exception.scope: One obsolete-email literal in a parsed rejection assertion; all other bytes and categories remain scanned.

scope: Read-only signature/contact scan, including streamed gzip text. Reports contain categories and paths, never matched values. Pattern matching does not prove absence of every secret. Binary image/array payloads are not interpreted as text; PDFs are text/metadata-scanned locally. This is upload hygiene, not proof validation, source licensing review or scientific replay.

copy_filter_check.scope: Existing staging snapshot is historical until prepare_github runs. Expected files are scanned in the new full archive; missing files are normal before preparation. Extra old files would survive its copy-only update and require review.

original_raw_check.scope: Named forbidden original raw paths plus the cohort-tagged frozen target/direct-copy columns; no claim to detect arbitrary disguised numeric encodings.
